features.remaining_work: Bindings and item actions exist. Add skill/command dispatch, native cooldowns, tooltips, tree prerequisites/arrows and rejection feedback. Preserve the 400-byte file and native IDs.

Implement target/range/LOS, costs, cast/ready/apply phases, cooldowns, interrupts and area/projectile outcomes. Connect native motions/TFX to authoritative results. Current `C/app/tantra_remake_main.cpp:999` explicitly rejects skill bindings.

features.remaining_work: Solo progression, ordinary money bags and eight direct drop decks exist. Complete reward groups/modifiers, pickup stack merging, ownership/party rights, manual drop and decay. Current `defeated()` sets lifetime zero and retains drops until pickup/teardown.

Current `C/client/OfflineWorldGameplay.cpp::useItem` supports ordinary instant HP/TP recovery and rejects other costs/phases/effects. Add charged/timed/continuous items and supported travel/revival/summoning items in native consumption/cancellation order.
Add prerequisites, acceptance/progress/failure/completion, triggers, choices, exactly-once rewards and persistent history/journal. Quest bytes in CHAR_INIT do not implement this.

`OfflineNpcServices::enter` only handles a small condition subset, limited quest markers and basic supported events. Implement enabled tribe/job/Trimuriti/quest/request-result conditions, religion/class advancement, contributions/ranks and other source-backed callbacks.

Add native eligibility, materials/currency, slot locks, probability/RNG decks, success/failure/destruction, rollback and original result UI. Existing repair is a different, already implemented service.

features.native_or_current_evidence: `N/zone/server.cpp:4821`: portal request, teleport/move-zone handlers; client world transition handlers
features.remaining_work: Entry is not travel. Current `OfflineCharacterChannel.cpp:85` rejects nonzero position/portal/target variants. Implement portals, NPC transport and supported items, ownership transfer, save/unload/load/re-entry sequence and failed destination recovery.

Same-zone save/town recovery, original death UI and bounded Prana loss exist. Complete revival items/healers, another saved zone, supported fortress/special-zone branches and full penalty/effect rules. Current `revive()` rejects handoff to another non-alias zone.

Complete minimap/large-map markers and controls, supported sitting/rest/recovery, contextual commands/target restrictions and command quick slots. Some original command bodies are empty; trace active behavior before implementing.
Add text/IME input, recipient/range/channel rules, local/whisper/party/guild routing and reconnect handling. A chat panel or local echo is not a multiplayer chat service.
